newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Budapest bourse P/E ratio rises to 14.20 in Oct.
newsitem.headline: Budapest bourse P/E ratio rises to 14.20 in Oct.

text.p: The market price/earnings ratio rose to 14.20 in October from 13.89 in September, on the Budapest Stock Exchange (BSE), the BSE said in its monthly report.
The market price/book value advanced to 1.46 in October from 1.43 in September, it said.
The dividend yield rose to 1.53 percent from 1.45 percent in September. @
MARKET RATIOS ON THE BUDAPEST STOCK EXCHANGE
P/E ratio P/BV ratio Dividend yield(pct)

NOTE: From September 1995, the BSE has calculated P/E ratios by dividing total share capitalisation by total after-tax results (profits and losses). Previously P/E ratios were calculated for each company and were weighted by their registered capital.
